uncertainty: Whether guarantees are better collected in one named section or attached to each mechanism they constrain.
design: Both arms state the same eight guarantees, verified identical by substring. Only placement differs.

B.description: same facts inline beside each mechanism

rule_learned: A named, discoverable section outperforms contextual embedding for guarantees. Same facts, different placement, 0.47 apart at 24 standard deviations.
caveat: This measures what a grader can locate in a document. Whether it helps a reader answer a question is the separate, slower measurement at release. The cheap proxy chooses between variants; the expensive test validates the proxy.
